questions.q: Choose the option nearest in meaning to CANDID:

questions.q: Assets are ₹80,000 and liabilities are ₹30,000. What is the owner’s equity?

questions.subject: Economics
questions.q: Which of these is NOT a function of the Reserve Bank of India?
questions.why: Commercial banks accept public deposits. The RBI does not.

questions.subject: Accountancy
questions.q: Goodwill brought in by an incoming partner is shared by old partners in:
questions.why: Old partners are compensated for their sacrifice, so it is split in the sacrificing ratio.

questions.subject: Business Studies
questions.q: Comparing actual performance with a planned standard is part of which management function?
questions.why: Controlling compares actual performance with standards so deviations can be identified and corrected.
